label: prf:atom-knot-mass-derivation
title: Proof of the end-to-end mass derivation $B = \rho \cdot m_e \cdot \mathrm{Vol}_{\mathrm{hyp}}(\widehat{T_w})$
html:
Proof. After the pre-Archimedean / post-Archimedean simplification (Yekutieli at finite slices replaces any geometric-leg construction with finite-categorical Markov trace), the proof is a single pre-Archimedean categorical pipeline, terminated by the Archimedean realization functor. We treat the algebraic content first and then the functor.

Categorical (pre-Archimedean) leg

By prop:confinement-sdp, at substrate q_0 the joint mass-tower SDP admits a solution whose certificate includes, per atom \mathfrak{H} of strand count n_0, the canonical Hecke element T_w \in H_{n_0}(q_0) in Gröbner–Shirshov normal form. The GB-NF carries a length filtration \ell and a jet-order grading (\ell from Coxeter length on S_{n_0}; jet-order from the temporal sequence of reductions; both certificate components verified for small cases by the canonical formalism and locked in gb-filtration-jet-order.witness.json).

Yekutieli at finite slice (multiplicative integration on surfaces, restricted to finite slicing depth = filtration grade \leq k): the categorical action's holonomy on the braid \beta underlying T_w factors as the finite product \rho(\beta) = \prod_{j} \rho(\sigma_{i_j}). The non-abelian Stokes identity at adjacent slices reduces to braid + Hecke quadratic relations, which are the only E_2-differentials of the GB spectral sequence (prop:gb-spectral-sequence). The spectral sequence collapses at E_2 for semisimple H_n(q) at generic q (prop:spectral-sequence-collapse) because no relations beyond braid + Hecke exist; E_\infty identifications recover Wedderburn (prop:e-infinity-page-identifications).

Wedderburn for the semisimple algebra H_n(q) over the splitting field \mathbb{Q}(q^{1/2}) gives H_n(q) \cong \bigoplus_\lambda M_{d_\lambda}(\mathbb{Q}(q^{1/2})) where \lambda ranges over partitions of n and d_\lambda is the dimension of the S_n-irreducible \lambda (prop:wedderburn-trace-identity). Under this decomposition the Markov trace on H_n(q) takes the finite-sum form \mathrm{tr}_M = \sum_\lambda y_\lambda(q) \chi_\lambda where y_\lambda(q) = s_{\lambda, r}(Q) / Z is the Wenzl-bridge coefficient (thm:jones-markov-trace, prop:alpha-k-derivation-procedure) and \chi_\lambda is the q-Murnaghan–Nakayama character.

The categorical mass invariant. Setting M(\mathfrak{H}) := \nu_{\mathrm{SDP}} \cdot \mathrm{tr}_M(T_w) = \nu_{\mathrm{SDP}} \cdot \sum_\lambda y_\lambda(q) \chi_\lambda(T_w) gives an element of \mathbb{Q}(q). Every quantity is finite-sum and exact; the spectral-sequence collapse at E_2 guarantees no higher analytic content (asymptotic at roots of unity, volume conjecture, Reeb-density integral on the cover, etc.) is needed. \nu_{\mathrm{SDP}} \in \mathbb{Z}_{>0} is read off as the multiplicity of T_w's SDP solution in the Wedderburn decomposition (renamed from \rho to disambiguate from the categorical density \rho_K of prop:atomic-mass-gb-nf and the Hoefsmit irrep \rho_\lambda).

Archimedean realization

The Archimedean realization functor (def:archimedean-realization-functor) sends \mathbb{Q}(q) \to \mathbb{R} by evaluating at q_0 and fixes the dimensional bridge so that m_e \cdot M(\mathfrak{H})|_{q = q_0} has units of MeV:

B(\mathfrak{H}) \;:=\; m_e \cdot M(\mathfrak{H}) \big|_{q = q_0} \;=\; m_e \cdot \nu_{\mathrm{SDP}} \cdot \mathrm{tr}_M(T_w) \big|_{q = q_0} \;\in\; \mathbb{R}.

This is the binding-energy prediction.

Post-Archimedean naming (borrowed, not part of derivation)

If K = \widehat{T_w} is hyperbolic then by the volume conjecture [kashaev1997, murakami-murakami2001] the asymptotic 2\pi \lim_{N \to \infty} (1/N) \log |J_K(\zeta_N)| at roots of unity \zeta_N = e^{2\pi i / N} equals \mathrm{Vol}_{\mathrm{hyp}}(K), where J_K(q) = \mathrm{tr}_M(T_w) is the Jones polynomial. Combined with Mostow rigidity [mostow1968] and Gromov's norm theorem [gromov1982, thurston1978], the post-Archimedean number admits the conventional 3-manifold-theory name \mathrm{Vol}_{\mathrm{hyp}}(K).

This is borrowed, conventional, and used only as naming. The QOU mass identity above does not depend on the volume conjecture in any way: it is a finite-sum categorical statement, terminated by the Archimedean realisation.

Concluding identity

Combining the categorical leg and the Archimedean realisation,

B(\mathfrak{H}) \;=\; m_e \cdot \nu_{\mathrm{SDP}} \cdot \mathrm{tr}_M(T_w) \big|_{q = q_0}.

For hyperbolic K = \widehat{T_w} this number coincides with \nu_{\mathrm{SDP}} \cdot m_e \cdot \mathrm{Vol}_{\mathrm{hyp}}(K) via the volume conjecture, which is the conventional way of writing the same identity. \square

Methodological preconditions

The proof above presumes the joint-tower SDP is constructively in place (step 1 of the algorithm). Within the present implementation:

  • For principled-derivation entries (electron, proton, neutron) the explicit \sigma-words are direct (electron \sigma_1^3 in H_2, proton/neutron (\sigma_1 \sigma_2^{-1})^3 in B_3); steps 2–6 of the algorithm run end-to-end. \nu_{\mathrm{SDP}} = 1 by definition.
  • For manual-historical entries ({}^2H, {}^{3}H, {}^{3}He) step 1 is pending; the post-Archimedean naming (volume from SnapPy) is substituted for the categorical Markov trace, justified by the volume conjecture. Re-running step 1 with the joint-tower SDP would replace this substitution with a principled derivation.
  • For recursive-on-⁴He ({}^{8}Be–{}^{40}Ca) the recursion factors through the {}^{4}He magic-A formula and inherits its methodology.
  • A volume-match search that runs backwards from step 6 to a candidate knot, bypassing step 1 entirely, is excluded: it reverse-engineers the knot from the AME target rather than deriving it from the categorical pipeline. The principled atlas (prop:recursive-atom-knot-atlas) admits no such entry.

The collapsing-spectral-sequence framing (prop:gb-spectral-sequence, prop:spectral-sequence-collapse) is what allows step 2 (Markov trace) to be a finite sum: E_\infty-page identifications recover Wedderburn after one nontrivial differential, so no infinite-page resolution is needed and no asymptotic content enters the categorical leg.
